description: FiveM suspicious (but not necessarily malicious) code patterns

rules.name: HTTP Request to Non-Standard Endpoint
rules.description: Makes an HTTP request to an external domain. Legitimate scripts use this for updates, but it can be used for remote payloads.
rules.recommendation: Verify that the requested domain is trusted.

rules.name: Raw SQL Query Construction
rules.description: Constructs SQL queries using string concatenation. This can be vulnerable to SQL injection if player input is used.
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements.

rules.name: TriggerClientEvent Broadcast
rules.description: Triggers a client event on all connected players (-1 source). Verify that no sensitive client operations are triggered globally.
rules.recommendation: Review the event payload. Ensure it does not transmit sensitive configuration.

rules.name: Programmatic Resource Management
rules.description: Programmatically stops or starts resources. This can be used by backdoors to disable security/logging resources.
rules.recommendation: Ensure this resource is authorized to manage other resources.

rules.name: Sensitive File Read Access
rules.description: Reads files from sensitive paths or searches for credential keywords.
rules.recommendation: Ensure no sensitive configuration or database credentials are read and transmitted.
